immutable_ref_policy: A formal candidate is classified only at a full Git commit, with tree, file blob, source hash, toolchain, dependency, and license identities where available. A moving public-index revision is discovery evidence only and is never silently substituted for the repository pin.
credentials_policy: Anonymous public HTTP only. No authenticated GitHub code-search credential was available; access and rate-limit failures are recorded as failures, not negative results.
network_policy: Read-only metadata, raw-source, and public-index queries only. No dependency clone, fetch, Lake update, Lake build, or .lake mutation is permitted.
search_order: repository-local Lean proof bodies and wrappers outside the owned statement dossier
all manifest-materialized pinned package Lean sources
pinned mathlib declarations, proof bodies, history, and downstream consumers
credible public Lean 4 repositories through bounded code and repository indices
formal-conjecture and statement collections at immutable indexed commits

query_families: exact author, construction, paper-title, and arXiv identifier literals

expected_negative_evidence: Every bounded public query records a dated complete result and response SHA-256, or an explicit access failure. No internet-wide absence or discovery-saturation claim is permitted.
successor_policy: New discoveries are append-only and require a successor inventory version; records are not deleted or reclassified merely to improve coverage.
